title: Bag of Bricks - Grey 39
descriptionHtml:
Grey — colour 39

The balanced mid-grey that does the quiet work in every greyscale build. Rarely the colour anyone notices, always the one that runs out halfway through a black-and-white portrait.

Works well with: Dark Grey 31, Stone Grey 36, White 37

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Grey bricks (colour 39) for Memobrick mosaics. A balanced mid-grey that does the quiet work in every greyscale portrait.
